_comment: Hand-authored representative payload, not a live capture — sedeaplicaciones.minetur.gob.es is egress-blocked from this sandbox (confirmed: CONNECT tunnel returns 403), same as every other price endpoint in T06/T07. The real endpoint returns ~12k stations nationwide in this exact shape (documented field names, comma-decimal prices); this fixture keeps a handful representative of that shape rather than reproducing all ~12k rows, since none could be captured live. Treat 'the fixture parses into a valid Station[]' and 'the live endpoint answers with this shape' as two separate claims — the second needs a live Vercel-preview check per docs/DATA-SOURCES.md.
